[1/2] Keystone testbed cycle: cover versioned scene snapshots, assets, environment settings, validation and in-place restore

impact_assessment.why: scene_snapshot persists editor/runtime scenes but the testbed covers it only through component-codec and editor paths, leaving environment/assets/validation and restore semantics untested.
impact_assessment.benefits: Five tests pin node/transform/tag/parent round trips, camera/light/settings, registry asset wiring, malformed snapshots and in-place restore replacement.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tests only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: in-memory scenes/registries; no game/sim/hash change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Small scenes and explicit ids, full suite, determinism and project gates.
